headline: Oxfam report says Israel has contaminated over 99 percent of Gaza with toxic pollution
label: NEWS
caption:
A new international report warns that the ongoing conflict has left the region heavily polluted. 🌍

According to Oxfam and Al Jazeera, Israel may have contaminated over 99 percent of Gaza throughout the war.

Reports describe the area as a toxic wasteland due to severe environmental destruction and pollution caused by military operations.

Humanitarian organizations attribute these conditions to ongoing environmental crimes that threaten the health of the local population.
